name: 89429 · Silver Spgs, NV
findings: ZIP 89429 (Silver Spgs) has 19 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 6 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89429 (Silver Spgs) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 89429 (Silver Spgs) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.0 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
